text:
olivia.support: FYI customer reported a promo claim that shows UI success / email confirmation but org balance is still 0. Org: org-acme-789, claim_id: 8f3b2c, code: WELCOME-ACME-2025. Customer says web callback returned 200 and portal shows green check. Screenshot attached.

matt.oncall: Can you paste the claim_id/org_id (thanks). I will grep the ingest logs and ledger.

olivia.support: org-acme-789, claim 8f3b2c, reported 2026-03-16T22:14Z. Customer provided webhook response (200).

ingest-bot: webhook received claim_id=8f3b2c status=ACK route=webflow payload_len=642

matt.oncall: quick grep: webhook was ACKed but mapper service logged an error when trying to map to billing_profile. No ledger_tx found for claim_id=8f3b2c. Relevant snippet:
```
ERROR mapper: missing billing_profile for org org-acme-789 (migration:billing_profile_v2)
stack: mapper/handleWebhook->mapper/applyToLedger
```

lee.billing: on it. This looks like the known migration gap — some orgs didn't get a billing_profile during the v2 migration. If mapper can't find a billing_profile we skip ledger writes to avoid orphan credits.

olivia.support: Customer asks why UI showed success then. They have screenshots of the web client confirming acceptance. Anything I can tell them now?

lee.billing: The UI confirmation comes from the partner/webflow ack path (we ack the webhook quickly). That doesn't guarantee ledger write. Short term workaround: I can apply the credits manually from billing console and force a ledger_tx. I'll queue a manual apply and reply here once done.

matt.oncall: I'll open an ops ticket to reprocess failed/missing mappings and add the claim_id to a replay queue after we backfill billing_profile. Proposed actions: (1) manual apply for customer (2) backfill billing_profile for org-acme-789 (3) reprocess the original webhook to create ledger_tx (4) add detection alert for mapper skips.

lee.billing: Manual apply completed, created ledger_tx tx-99234 for +1000 credits. Customer notified and balance should reflect within 2-5 mins. Posting ephemeral note to the customer that this was applied manually.

olivia.support: I told customer we applied the credits manually and will follow up with a postmortem. They asked for ETA on fix.

matt.oncall: ETA for backfill + reprocess: I will schedule the migration fix tomorrow morning in the low-traffic window and run a targeted reprocess for org-acme-789 after validation. Will update this thread with the run id and outcome.

olivia.support: Thanks team — closing the immediate support loop. Customer asked for a short root-cause summary once available. tagging: @lee.billing @matt.oncall. :thumbsup:

ingest-bot: replay-queue: enqueued claim_id=8f3b2c for reprocess after backfill

lee.billing: follow-up created in billing tracker: BILL-4579 (migration-backfill + replay). Assigned to me.

matt.oncall: added detection rule PR to alert on mapper skip rate > 0.2% (PR: https://git.internal/r/mapper-alerts/pull/12).

olivia.support: Noted. I'll send the manual-apply confirmation to the customer and request acceptance. Thread will stay open until postmortem done.
__notes: Generated synthetic Slack thread about a promo code accepted in UI but not applied due to missing billing_profile mapping. Contains root message and subsequent troubleshooting, short messages, code snippet, bot messages, and actions.
